strategies.name: Repeated Masked AllReduce Chain
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all_reduce operations where each rank masks its window blocks before and after each reduction, dividing by overlap counts between reductions. This is the reference approach with 8 all_reduce dispatches. Trades maximum dispatch count for simplest logic and smallest per-dispatch payload (only window blocks communicated).

strategies.name: Fused Window-Broadcast with Single AllReduce
strategies.desc: Performs one initial all_reduce to get global sum, then 7 all_gather operations to broadcast window-specific scaling metadata across ranks, applying all masks and divisions locally. Total 8 dispatches but shifts work from all_reduce to cheaper all_gather on scalar metadata. Trades collective type diversity for potential bandwidth savings.

strategies.name: Block-Parallel Reduce-Scatter then AllGather
strategies.desc: Splits the 10 blocks into reduce-scatter partitions (each rank owns subset of blocks), performs 8 dependent reduce-scatter operations with per-block scaling logic, then final all_gather to reconstruct full result. Uses 16 total dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but enables parallelism across blocks and reduces per-rank memory pressure during intermediate stages.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Stage AllReduce Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes the 8 all_reduce chain into intra-node then inter-node passes, leveraging num_nodes topology at world_size=224. First performs 8 node-local reductions, then 8 cross-node reductions with different ring/tree topologies. Total 16 dispatches but exploits faster intra-node links and reduces cross-node traffic by factor of cores_per_device.

strategies.name: Pre-Aggregated Single AllReduce with Local Iteration
strategies.desc:
Precomputes all 8 iteration results locally by simulating the mask/divide sequence on local data, stacks them into extended tensor of shape (8, 10, 384), performs single all_reduce on concatenated buffer, then extracts final iteration result. Reduces to 1 dispatch with 8x payload size, trading network message count for bandwidth and local compute.

    OFF = 2

    # Initial all_reduce to get sum across all ranks
